rows.actor: Owner or either Viewer scope holding valid identifiers from another library
rows.expected: Generic 404 for reads and Owner attempts; a Viewer mutation may use role-safe 403; no disclosure or state change
rows.actual: All attempts returned 403/404 as specified; database, private objects and audit rows were unchanged

rows.actor: Owner or either Viewer scope holding a valid foreign book identifier
rows.expected: Generic denial, no foreign metadata or cover bytes disclosed, no state change
rows.actual: Reads and Owner writes returned 404; Viewer writes returned 403/404; real foreign cover metadata and bytes remained unchanged

rows.actor: Owner or either Viewer scope holding valid foreign reading or loan identifiers
rows.expected: Generic denial without borrower, notes, identifiers or state changes
rows.actual: All attempts returned 403/404 as specified; private loan markers were absent and snapshots were unchanged

rows.actor: Owner or either Viewer scope holding valid foreign physical-library identifiers
rows.expected: Generic denial and no hierarchy, placement, layout or audit mutation
rows.actual: All attempts returned 403/404 as specified and complete physical snapshots were unchanged

rows.actor: Owner or either Viewer scope holding valid foreign invitation, job or library identifiers
rows.expected: Generic denial, no identifier disclosure and no state or byte change
rows.actual: All attempts returned 403/404 as specified; invitation, job, export and audit state remained unchanged

rows.actor: Owner, catalogue-only Viewer and catalogue-and-map Viewer in the same library
rows.expected: Shared catalogue and private cover are readable with a read-only Viewer projection and no storage metadata
rows.actual: All actors received 200; Viewer can_edit was false and no storage key, digest or uploader identity was exposed

rows.actor: Either Viewer scope
rows.expected: Generic 404 and no catalogue, contributor, cover-object or audit mutation
rows.actual: Every operation returned 404 and exact database, object-byte and audit snapshots remained unchanged

rows.endpoint: POST|GET|PUT|DELETE catalogue and private-cover lifecycle endpoints
rows.actor: Owner
rows.expected: Complete authorized lifecycle with ordered contributors and corresponding audit events
rows.actual: Create, update, delete, cover replace/remove/restore and all expected audit events succeeded

rows.actor: Owner selecting own or another Owner's reading perspective
rows.expected: Own perspective writable; another Owner's perspective read-only; concurrent active reader rejected atomically
rows.actual: Own lifecycle succeeded, cross-Owner finish returned 404, competing start returned 409 and state was unchanged

rows.endpoint: GET|PUT /reading-perspective(s); GET reading, overview, statistics and Goodreads projections
rows.actor: Either Viewer scope
rows.expected: May select and read an Owner perspective but cannot mutate personal reading data
rows.actual: Read projections returned 200 and every reading mutation returned 403/404 with unchanged state

rows.actor: Owner and either Viewer scope
rows.expected: Owners share custody; Viewers receive aggregate state without borrower or private notes and cannot mutate
rows.actual: Owners saw shared private fields; Viewer projections and audit omitted them; every Viewer mutation was denied without state change

rows.actor: Owner
rows.expected: Map is editable; preview is read-only; apply performs the reviewed rearrangement
rows.actual: Owner projection and apply returned 200, preview changed no state and apply moved the expected books

rows.actor: Catalogue-only Viewer; catalogue-and-map Viewer
rows.expected: Catalogue-only receives 404; map Viewer receives a non-editable map projection
rows.actual: Responses were respectively 404 and 200 with can_edit false

rows.endpoint: POST|PUT|DELETE physical furniture, placement, layout and rearrangement endpoints
rows.actor: Either Viewer scope
rows.expected: Generic 404 and no physical hierarchy, layout, placement or audit mutation
rows.actual: Every attempted mutation returned 404 and exact snapshots remained unchanged

rows.actor: Either Viewer scope
rows.expected: Catalogue-safe member summary only; all membership management denied without state change
rows.actual: Safe summary succeeded; mutations were generically denied and library, membership, invitation and audit snapshots were unchanged

rows.actor: Owner
rows.expected: May change Viewer scope, promote, downgrade, remove and revoke while preserving a final Owner
rows.actual: Lifecycle succeeded; revoked invitations stayed unusable and the final Owner could not remove itself

rows.endpoint: Any library endpoint after membership removal; concurrent PATCH /members/{owner_id}
rows.actor: Removed Owner with the original established session; two Owners removing each other concurrently
rows.expected: Established session loses library authority immediately; concurrent removals leave exactly one Owner
rows.actual: Original session was denied; PostgreSQL gate requires one success, one safe rejection and one surviving Owner

rows.actor: Either Viewer scope, unrelated Owner or removed Owner with an established session
rows.expected: Generic denial for valid foreign/stale identifiers with no database or staged/exported byte change
rows.actual: Every unauthorized operation was denied and exact database and byte snapshots remained unchanged

rows.endpoint: POST /imports/{job_id}/consolidate with Server ZIP identity mapping
rows.actor: Destination Owner supplying invalid, omitted or valid personal-data mapping
rows.expected: Non-Owner or omitted mapping rejected atomically; explicit destination-Owner mapping accepted
rows.actual: Invalid mappings added no books, readings or objects and kept the job ready; valid mapping succeeded

rows.actor: Former Viewer, unrelated user and original Owner after the 48-hour deadline
rows.expected: Generic denial and unchanged recovery tombstone
rows.actual: All unauthorized or expired restores were denied and the complete tombstone remained unchanged

rows.actor: Deleting account with two established sessions and holder of an expired genuine recovery token
rows.expected: All sessions revoked immediately; expired token rejected and unconsumed; cleanup removes identity/private object material
rows.actual: Both sessions returned 401, expired restore failed without consumption, and finalization removed all specified material

rows.actor: Current account and anonymous caller
rows.expected: Current account sees only documented private fields; anonymous caller receives 401; no object metadata leaks
rows.actual: Projection contained only five documented identity fields, anonymous requests returned 401 and image keys/digests were absent

rows.actor: Co-Owner, both Viewer scopes, foreign Owner, unrelated authenticated user and anonymous caller
rows.expected: Only explicit visibility groups receive the projection; private/inactive/absent resources share a 404 shape
rows.actual: Every visibility combination matched policy; private images returned indistinguishable 404 and denied reads changed no state

rows.actor: Owner, Viewer, unrelated authenticated user and anonymous caller
rows.expected: Private aggregate ratios only; Owner sees owned libraries, others no allocations, anonymous receives 401
rows.actual: Projection followed ownership and omitted raw bytes, plan codes and foreign identities

rows.endpoint: Every unsafe /api/v1 route discovered from the FastAPI route table
rows.actor: Authenticated user without a valid CSRF pair
rows.expected: Every authenticated mutation requires CSRF except the seven public lifecycle routes; preview remains read-only
rows.actual: Dynamic route inventory found no mutation without an explicit CSRF decision

rows.actor: Attacker fixing root-path cookies and user holding old/mixed session and CSRF values
rows.expected: Login replaces and expires shadowing cookies; rotation rejects every stale or mixed secret pair
rows.actual: Attacker values were not stored; old/old, old/new and new/old pairs failed while the new/new pair succeeded

rows.endpoint: POST /auth/sessions/revoke-all; subsequent GET /auth/me and authenticated mutations
rows.actor: Account with two independently established session/CSRF pairs
rows.expected: Revocation invalidates both pairs before any further read or mutation
rows.actual: Both sessions returned 401 and their subsequent mutations were rejected

rows.endpoint: POST /libraries/{library_id}/catalogue after authentication but concurrent membership removal
rows.actor: Owner whose established request loses membership between authentication and resource authorization
rows.expected: Request rechecks membership, returns generic 404 and creates no book while account session remains valid
rows.actual: Deterministic interleaving returned 404, created no book and preserved account authentication without library access

findings.summary: A root-path session cookie could shadow the genuine /api/v1 session cookie during login or logout.
The cross-library cover fixture originally exercised nonexistent covers, allowing an unscoped lookup to resemble a safe 404.
The removed-Owner check originally created a fresh post-removal session instead of retaining the pre-removal session.
